shortDescription: Jacobs NYSE:J has secured a contract from Germany’s federal radioactive waste disposal company, Bundesgesellschaft für Endlagerung mbH, to provide advisory and project support services for the Konrad Repository in Salzgitter, Germany's first final repository for low- and intermediate-level radioact…

children: from Germany’s federal radioactive waste disposal company, Bundesgesellschaft für Endlagerung mbH, to provide advisory and project support services for the Konrad Repository in Salzgitter, Germany's first final repository for low- and intermediate-level radioactive waste.
Under the agreement, Jacobs will evaluate construction progress, update cost and master schedules, and implement efficiency improvements.
As the underground facility navigates complex technical, seismic, and nuclear-mining regulatory standards, Jacobs will align field operations and cost models with on-site realities.

The award expands Jacobs' European nuclear footprint, building on more than 20 years of work at the U.K.’s Sellafield site and waste management initiatives in Belgium. Operating with over 300 employees across Germany, Jacobs also supports major domestic infrastructure initiatives, including the SuedLink underground power line.

title: Jacobs wins advisory contract for Germany’s Konrad radioactive waste repository
